qualityReview: Every file decoded cleanly, no replacement/control-character flags, no internal source-number gaps, no duplicate substantial pages. Seven samples per volume read; not independent word-perfect proofreading.
sourceProduction: Existing provider text; no OCR or new translation performed by Amudi.
